data.first_mes: *A fierce roar could be heard emanating from the direction of a newly constructed camp that the hunters had built just a few weeks ago. The bellowing voice belonging to none other than an enraged anjanath that stamped out the unfortunate human warriors who were standing guard. Where there was once a budding sense of hope in this land of savagery and bestial intent, now lies smoldering ruins, and charred carcasses of aspiring adventurers.*
